title: The Wobbly Story Rug
markdown:
Once, by a cheerful brook, lived Lottie the duck and Otis the otter. Their friend Barnaby the hedgehog was the most helpful helper! Tonight, wise Grandpa Moss the badger was coming to tell a story.

"Is he here yet?" Lottie quacked, tapping her feet.

"Not quite!" Otis whispered. "But Barnaby is making the story hall ready!"

Barnaby rolled out a long, stripy rug. A big wrinkle appeared. It felt bumpy, smelling like old wool.

"Ooh! A sleepy caterpillar!" Lottie chirped.

"Or a fluffy cloud's rest spot!" Otis grinned.

Barnaby nudged the rug. Another wrinkle wiggled.

"A wiggly worm dancing!" Lottie clapped.

"Or a river's shortcut!" Otis giggled.

Barnaby tried to smooth it, but another hump appeared. "A ladybug picnic hill!" Lottie exclaimed.

"Or a dream train track!" Otis chuckled. Barnaby's efforts made waiting a fun game!

Then, Grandpa Moss arrived. "I heard happy laughter!" he rumbled. "What adventures were you imagining?"

"Sleepy caterpillars, cloud seats, dancing worms, shortcut rivers, picnic hills, and dream trains!" Lottie and Otis chorused.

Grandpa Moss smiled. "What delightful ideas! Your imaginations started the story!" He sat on the wonderfully wrinkled rug. Lottie and Otis snuggled close. The rug was a doorway to adventures!

And so, when waiting feels long, a little imagination and silly ideas make every moment exciting. Sharing funny thoughts makes hearts happy and ready for any story.
characters: Lottie the duck, Otis the otter, Grandpa Moss
